FLEXIBLE AND SUPPORTIVE
AVAILABLE MULTIFUNCTION TAILGATE. This is cargo management made easy.
Conventional tailgate operation joins 60/40-split swing-away doors with a 2,000-lb load
rating. It’s better in every way: closer access to the bed from the bumper, simpler step-up,
more convenient loading/unloading (even with a forklift), faster washing out of the bed—
and with no need to remove a trailer and/or hitch to open it. (Requires spray-in bedliner.)
eTORQUE TECHNOLOGY AT A GLANCE. Standard on the Pentastar® V6 and
available for the HEMI® V8 on Ram 1500, eTorque is a mild-hybrid system which
eliminates the alternator and combines a motor generator with a 48-volt battery.
Main technological features include:
THE AVAILABLE CLASS-EXCLUSIVE ACTIVE-LEVELTM FOUR-CORNER AIR SUSPENSION.7
Electric Power Boost, which provides optimized efficiency and greater Pioneered by Ram 1500, it remains unique to the Light-Duty Truck segment. Either
supplemental torque during acceleration and enables the HEMI V8 Multi- automatic or driver-operated, the system is available on select trim levels, with five
Displacement System to operate longer while in 4-cylinder mode. modes that address a wide variety of needs, including off-road ride height, aerodynamic
Stop/Start Technology helps to improve efficiency by seamlessly turning off efficiency, ease of cargo access and occupant convenience.
the engine at idle stops and restarting operation at acceleration. With eTorque, The available Active-Level Four-Corner Air Suspension System uses an air supply component
the engine restart takes only half the time compared to normal Stop/Start. in a single unit to reduce weight and increase capacity.
Regenerative Braking recovers braking energy and converts it into electricity— The five operational modes are engineered to deliver outstanding performance from your
which helps recharge the onboard battery system. Ram 1500. They include two Off-Road Heights, the Aero Mode, Normal Ride Height and the
chassis-lowering Entry/Exit Mode.
